title: Balik Kampung Tak Lonely Lagi
overview: Megat, a pampered child who enjoys being alone. He likes watching horror movies, which influences his life. He is also a promising figure at work but has a tendency to steal bones. One day, Megat returns to the village for a family day. But what if those gathered are escaped ghosts who want to become a family and haunt his journey back home to his hometown?
